name: My Protogen Engineer ⚙️
source:
My Protogen Engineer tells the story of Marven, a Protogen mercenary who almost died on his last mission. Gladly, his teammates brought him to the only person who could save him - Xena. Being a very talented engineer, Xena saved Marven's brain and transplanted it into a functional mechanical body. Now he has to adapt to his new life and find a new purpose, a new meaning to his life. But at least he's not alone, Xena will be there to help him!

Follow Marven and Xena on this journey, find more about their common past and just spend time together with them!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844500/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《我的原质工程师》讲述了原质雇佣兵马文的故事，他在上次任务中差点丧命。很高兴，他的队友把他带到了唯一能拯救他的人——西娜身边。作为一名非常有才华的工程师，西娜拯救了马文的大脑并将其移植到一个功能正常的机械身体中。现在他必须适应新的生活，找到新的目标，新的人生意义。但至少他并不孤单，西娜会在那里帮助他！

跟随马文和西娜踏上这段旅程，了解更多关于他们共同的过去，并与他们共度时光！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844500/]Steam[/url]]
